rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Item dated 7 May 2004, 14:20, Moscow, Kremlin: the President confirmed that he had received that day the premier's order ('распоряжение премьер-министра') on the Government's surrender of its powers.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The same item states that the President had signed a decree instructing the Government to perform its duties until the State Duma approves the cabinet (links decree No. 585).

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: At the same meeting the head of state said that he would submit Mikhail Fradkov's candidacy to the State Duma that day for approval as Chairman of the Government.
